result.title: CEMIR vs. FISER: a comparative study of reasoning-based and enrichment-based approaches to pragmatic intent recognition
result.summary: Intent recognition in human-robot interaction requires agents to resolve ambiguous natural language instructions by inferring the speaker's underlying goals. Research has increasingly focused on two notable paradigms for addressing this task: structured symbolic reasoning and multimodal input enrichment. However, it remains unclear whether enrichment-based methods provide benefit in settings where the ambiguity concerns unstated human intent rather than missing observable scene information. In this paper, we present a comparative and diagnostic study benchmarking FISER - a framework utilizing structured social and embodied reasoning - against CEMIR (Context-Enriched Multimodal Intent Recognition), a method that performs multimodal enrichment by synthesizing narratives and photorealistic images from textual prompts. By evaluating both approaches across four Large Language Models (LLMs), ranging from Qwen2.5-Omni-3B to GPT-5, on the HandMeThat v2 benchmark, we analyze their capability to resolve pragmatic ambiguities. Our statistical analysis, employing multiple-comparison correction, reveals no statistically significant difference in performance between FISER and CEMIR across any model or difficulty level. This pattern holds across all sixteen model-by-difficulty comparisons, as well as in a targeted ablation isolating CEMIR's narrative and visual components. Instead, performance is primarily associated with backbone capability and the inherent difficulty of the ambiguity. These findings suggest a boundary condition for text-derived multimodal enrichment: when the relevant task constraints are already available in the textual instruction, synthetic multimodal augmentation may not provide measurable benefit over structured reasoning on the same text.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 HandMeThat v2 上对两种语用意图识别路线做对比诊断：FISER 依赖结构化社会与具身推理，CEMIR 则从文本提示合成叙事与写实图像进行多模态增强，并在 Qwen2.5-Omni-3B 到 GPT-5 四个模型上评测，结果显示两者在任何模型与难度层级上均无统计显著差异，性能主要由底座能力与歧义固有难度决定。
AI.relevance_reason: 负结果直接触及「视觉旁路是否有用」的边界条件：当任务约束已存在于文本中时，文本衍生的合成视觉证据可能不带来增益，可为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与信息冗余的判断提供核查线索；但该工作不含 latent 状态生成或内部表示分析。
